## Problem and change

Describe the observed problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if any.
English and Korean are welcome.

## Verification

Use the [verification guide](https://github.com/miinhlym/viewstem/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#verification) to choose the checks relevant to your change.
[한국어 검증 안내](https://github.com/miinhlym/viewstem/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.ko.md#검증)
List the commands you ran and their results. Explain any checks you could not run.
For bug fixes, name the regression test (file and test case) that fails before the fix and passes afterward. If you could not add or run that test, explain why and describe the evidence you checked instead.
For visible changes, include a screenshot or describe the before and after behavior.

## Compatibility and documentation

Describe changes to public APIs, declarations, supported behavior, or dependencies.
Identify third-party material and its license if any was added.

- [ ] I reviewed the change and have the right to submit it under the contribution licensing terms.
- [ ] Relevant tests and owning documentation are updated, or I explained why they are not needed.
- [ ] Generated files were changed through their source/generator where applicable.

<!-- AI-assisted changes have the same review and verification requirements. -->
